title: VeloraOS 1.10.55 - iOS Layout & Keyboard Polish
releaseNotes: Fixes the standalone iPhone/iPad Chat composer being covered by the bottom tab bar.
Uses deterministic native header and tab-bar geometry so the message timeline, composer and navigation never overlap.
Hides the tab bar while the iOS keyboard is open and anchors the composer directly above the keyboard using the Visual Viewport.
Improves keyboard focus, blur and orientation handling and keeps the latest conversation content visible during keyboard transitions.
Refines the mobile header and tab bar sizing and adds a native send-button ready state when text or an image is queued.
Keeps only the message timeline scrollable while the app header, composer and native navigation remain anchored.
